method_limits: Audit establishes registered local geometry availability and scene references. It does not validate any physical NVIDIA pixels, author a new canal line, or infer real shipping outcomes.
Archive passage geometry is sourced and generalized rather than arbitrary invented coordinates; its licensed provenance does not establish precision or whole-canal coverage.
Countries/coastlines and cartographic raster pixels cannot substitute for a canal feature without an authoritative geometry record.
The current scene artifacts are QA source plans with static and native admission receipts; existing uploaded BEFORE video has no v020 NVIDIA AFTER counterpart.
